name: serviciomigraciones.cl
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But certain ARIA roles must contain particular children.
lesson: Use native HTML elements first. When you use ARIA roles, nest them the way the role requires.
summary: serviciomigraciones.cl scores 74 out of 100 (C). 5 checks fail now, 25 are at risk, and 39 pass. Fix first: tracking starts before the visitor chooses.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (4 requests), Microsoft Clarity (5 requests), Google Ads (1 request), and cookies _gcl_au, _ga_96VSMKH6NV, _ga.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Certain ARIA roles must contain particular children
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 1 element on /quienes-somos/, for example #pp-advanced-accordion-a6a5981. Impact: critical.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /, /en/home/, for example .elementor-element-f46a22c > .elementor-widget-container > a and .elementor-element-123afb1 > .elementor-widget-container > a. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: A session recorder runs before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Microsoft Clarity sent recording data. Session recorders replay clicks, scrolling, and anything typed into fields they do not mask.
fix.fix: Load the recorder only after consent, and mask every form field in its settings.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: A window the page opens, or that opens it, keeps a handle to it, which tabnabbing and cross-site leaks use. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin-allow-popups, or same-origin when the site opens no sign-in or payment popup.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 296 ms
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
